title: Supplementary native screenshot review and saved-evidence credential check

provenance.method: Independent read-only inspection of saved native screenshots, source cross-checks and saved native-action JSON
provenance.capturedViewport: 1024 by 768 logical pixels; most PNGs are 2048 by 1536 Retina pixels
provenance.notAClaimOf: Every button tested, Windows validation, hardware validation, data persistence validation or a security certification

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Back Office customer account dialog, zero balance, account on hold, empty activity
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: No clipping, overlapping controls or missing visible footer actions observed in this captured state.
observations: Refresh and Close, balance adjustment actions, account settings and activity area fit the dialog.
The off switch is consistent with Account on hold: it controls Pay Later enablement, not a separate hold flag.

sourceCrossCheck.reason: Switch label selects Pay Later active when accountEnabledDraft is true and Account on hold when false.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Opening balance adjustment with a foreground error dialog
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Error message and acknowledgement control fit; backing form Cancel and Post Adjustment controls remain visible. No layout defect observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.functionalResult: The screenshot visibly confirms a failed customer account update reporting Customer Pay Later account was not found.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: The screenshot does not establish why the account is missing, whether any data was partially saved, or what subsequent refresh/retry does.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Customer loyalty dialog with zero current points and paired positive/negative manual adjustments
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: History, loyalty identifier and Adjust Points, Refresh and Close controls fit. No clipping or overlapping controls observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: A displayed zero following two opposite adjustments is not independent proof of persistence, history cleanup protection or multi-till synchronization.

supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Branding, explanatory text and business contact information fit the visible content area. No genuine content clipping observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: The partially visible bottom sidebar entry belongs to a scrollable navigation area; this screenshot alone does not prove it is inaccessible.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Back Office Stock Receiving with a one-line draft
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Supplier/reference controls, Add Note, Clear Draft, Add Products, line removal and Receive Stock footer fit the captured viewport. No clipping or overlapping action observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: This is only a one-line draft. It does not verify a long draft, expanded suggestion list, product picker, receipt posting, validation or persistence.

supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Restricted-product text, Do Not Add and ID Checked actions fit; no genuine dialog clipping observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: The prompt appearing does not prove all restricted item paths are protected.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Checkout with one restricted item in trolley after the preceding native test
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Trolley item, quantity controls, totals and checkout actions fit.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: The native-action sequence, not the filename or still image, is required to verify authorization and scan behavior.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Checkout with a new one-line trolley and no sale-complete overlay
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Main screen controls and totals fit without an overlay obscuring checkout.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: The still image does not independently establish that a scan dismissed the previous completion dialog. Refer to native-action sequence.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Checkout Pay Later confirmation with an enabled customer, zero prior balance and projected new balance
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Customer controls, account amount summary and Confirm Pay Later footer fit. No clipping or overlapping action observed.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: Confirmation display does not prove the resulting account charge is posted successfully.

supplementaryScreenshots.state: Checkout Pay Later confirmation still visible
supplementaryScreenshots.layoutResult: Visible layout fits, including Confirm Pay Later footer.
supplementaryScreenshots.limitations: Despite the filename, no pool-timeout message is visible in this PNG. Use native-actions.json as evidence for the recorded failure rather than claiming this image independently demonstrates it.

findings.classification: Observed functional failure, not a screenshot-confirmed UI defect
findings.title: New customer opening balance adjustment failed
findings.actual: Customer account update was rejected with Customer Pay Later account was not found.
findings.expected: An eligible customer's opening balance adjustment should post, or account initialization prerequisites should be explained before submission.
findings.rootCauseStatus: Not established by screenshot inspection; correlate native-action sequence and customer account backend path before fixing.

rejectedCandidates.candidate: Off switch appears inconsistent with Account on hold
rejectedCandidates.resolution: Not a defect: the switch controls account enablement; off correctly displays on hold. Confirmed in customer page source.
Not visually established: failure text is absent from this image. Recorded native action is separate evidence.

securityAudit.scope: Point-in-time evidence check of the saved native-action log and 64 named PNG files; not application security certification
patternCategoriesChecked: Credential-labelled assignments and high-entropy candidates in the earlier pass
observations: Attendance PIN and database password appear as masking dots, not readable values.
Native-action secure-field values are omitted, masked or explicitly redacted.
The earlier ten numeric-only keyboard action labels cover each keypad digit in a keyboard test; they are not evidence of a staff PIN being logged.
Dojo and SumUp screenshots do not reveal a saved secret API key.
Licence request QR encodes shop identity/till count based on page source, not a secret API credential; the signed licence input is empty.

optionalPrivacyRedactionBeforePublicShar.category: Shop identity, licence/request identifiers and request QR
Non-secret database host, username and database name

optionalPrivacyRedactionBeforePublicShar.files: Customer, staff, order, account and report screenshots generally
optionalPrivacyRedactionBeforePublicShar.category: Names, loyalty identifiers, receipts and sales values; user described this laptop data as mock

limitations: Heuristic scans and visual review can miss unusual secret formats; no exposed secret was observed, which is not proof that every possible secret has been excluded.
No credential values are reproduced in this report.
Files or native-action entries added after the recorded scan time are outside this point-in-time review and require a fresh check.

overallLimitations: This reviewer did not click any native button or change app data; all runtime sequences are owned by the root auditor.
Screenshots demonstrate only their captured state and viewport, not every responsive size, long content case, connected peripheral or Windows environment.
No product fixes or credential redactions were performed by this reviewer.
